# Contents LLC

> Marketing consulting and AI engineering that actually moves your numbers.
> We turn strategic business challenges into production-ready AI systems.

## About Us
Contents LLC is a team of AI engineers and consultants working alongside enterprise leaders and founder-led brands. We start by understanding the problem, not by picking technology, then design, build, and seamlessly integrate AI into everyday organizational workflows.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Strategy & Discovery**: Comprehensive workflow assessment, AI readiness, use case prioritization, and ROI roadmaps.
- **AI Agents**: Autonomous multi-agent systems and intelligent assistants capable of executing complex business workflows.
- **RAG & Enterprise Knowledge**: Custom retrieval-augmented generation engines securely connected to private company documents and databases.
- **AI Workflow Automation**: High-throughput automated pipelines that eliminate operational drag and repetitive manual tasks.
- **Custom AI Applications**: Bespoke internal tools, dashboards, and client-facing AI platforms.
- **AI Infrastructure**: Scalable cloud and on-premise deployments with enterprise-grade security and monitoring.

## Consultation & Pricing
- **Office Hours**: $30 (30-minute 1:1 single-topic deep focus session).
- **Strategy Intensive**: $500 (2-hour deep dive workshop + 12-page custom strategy document).
- **Monthly Partner**: $100/mo (Ongoing marketing & AI advisory on-call).
- **AI Vibe Code Consult**: $1,500 (30-minute codebase & Cursor/LLM optimization review).
- **AI Solutions Consult**: $15,000 (Full-day 6-hour enterprise architecture & build workshop).
- **AI & Automation Info-Ops**: $5,000 - $28,000 (Tactical to full-scale automated information operations).
